segments.text: proposition 1 THe ceremonies of the lawe, which conteined Chriſt apprehended by faith, may be granted to haue iuſtified.

proposition 2 When we ſaie that we be iuſtified by faith, we iudge, that faith muſt be vnderſtood for the diſpoſition and power, whereby we be made capable of the remiſſion of ſinnes, and righteouſneſſe of Chriſt.
proposition 3 We grant that a man is iuſtified by works; howbeit, that is touching inherent righteouſneſſe and reward, by the which righteouſnes we firſt obteine a good and holie life of God.
